response.justification: Bogdan is a highly skilled software craftsman with strong expertise in software architecture, testing methodologies, and mentorship. However, he falls significantly short of the critical minimum qualification of 8 years of C++ programming, possessing less than a year of professional C++ experience. Furthermore, his background is predominantly in web applications, Node.js, and DLang microservices, rather than the low-level compute technologies, hardware architecture, and deep cloud infrastructure required for this specific Technical Lead role.
strengths: Strong background in software design, architecture, and testing methodologies (TDD, CI/CD, Fluent-Asserts).
Proven track record of mentorship, technical leadership, and community engagement through workshops and courses.
Experience designing scalable microservices and event-driven platforms handling high request volumes.
concerns: Critically lacks the minimum 8 years of required C++ programming experience, with only a brief 7-month stint using it professionally.
Background heavily favors web and application backends (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang) over core cloud compute and hardware architecture.
Missing extensive production-level cloud infrastructure experience specifically geared toward internal compute platforms.
